/.title: Chizzy - Video chat with strangers who share your interests
/.description: Chizzy is a free, anonymous video chat that matches you with people who share your interests. Pick your topics, accept a match and start talking.

/terms.title: Terms of Service | Chizzy
/terms.description: The terms you agree to when you use Chizzy: who may use the service, the rules, automated safety tools, reports, appeals and liability.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Chizzy
/privacy.description: What Chizzy collects while you chat, how long it is kept, who can see it and the choices you have. We do not record video, audio or chat.

/guidelines.title: Community Guidelines | Chizzy
/guidelines.description: The rules for behaviour on Chizzy, what happens when someone breaks them and how reports are reviewed.

/safety.title: Safety | Chizzy
/safety.description: How to stay safe while video chatting with strangers on Chizzy, what to do if something goes wrong and where to get help.

/grievance.title: Grievance Officer | Chizzy
/grievance.description: How to reach Chizzy's grievance officer and how complaints are acknowledged and resolved.

/law-enforcement.title: Law enforcement requests | Chizzy
/law-enforcement.description: How law enforcement agencies can send requests to Chizzy, what data may exist, how long it is kept and how to ask for preservation.

/takedown.title: Report content for removal | Chizzy
/takedown.description: Ask Chizzy to remove content or report a user. Tell us what happened and we will review the request.
